package_004m.name: Controlled Accounting Periods and Close Governance

package_004n.name: Controlled Trial Balance and Financial Reporting
invariants: reports derive only from immutable accounting journal lines and governed period metadata
no persisted or editable report balance exists
year-end close and reversal journals remain in trial-balance/balance-sheet evidence
year-end close and reversal journals are excluded from operating P&L aggregation so historical operating performance remains visible
explicit accounting-view deny overrides finance.manage fallback

package_004o.name: Controlled Year-End Close and Retained Earnings
package_004o.status: release candidate on PR #39 pending exact-head CI
preconditions: complete financial year coverage by configured accounting periods
active retained_earnings semantic mapping to an equity account
revenue or expense movement for the selected currency
no active authorised close for the same financial year and currency
controls: source fingerprint re-derived under transaction before authorisation
balanced source-derived year_end_close journal dated financial-year end
profit credited to retained earnings and loss debited to retained earnings
additive journal reversal and reversal provenance
organisation accounting mutex serializes concurrent authorisation

validation.generated_kysely_drift: zero across core + collections + accounting outputs
validation.status: exact documentation-synchronised Package 004O head must reproduce the complete gate before merge

next_boundary.name: Controlled Statutory Financial Statements
recommended_sequence: derive statement periods only from governed financial years and accounting periods
consume immutable journal evidence and completed year-end-close provenance
define controlled statement presentation and comparative-period semantics
keep statement generation derived and non-editable
record publication/export evidence separately from journal facts
preserve currency separation and explicit accounting-view deny precedence
next_boundary.governing_rule: statutory-style statements must remain derived from governed accounting evidence; publication must never rewrite journals, period history or year-end-close provenance

open_product_gaps: General/direct contract creation remains absent; current formation is accepted-quotation-derived.
Accepted-quotation conversion edge case remains when the source estimate already has a project but conversion provenance is absent.
Statutory financial statements and filing remain the next accounting boundary.
Provider integrations, bank reconciliation, purchase-ledger/AP, cash-flow reporting and FX remain later boundaries.
